messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You should not take sertraline if you are allergic to sertraline or any of the ingredients in it.
You should not take sertraline if you take an MAOI or have taken one in the past 14 days.
You should not take sertraline if you take pimozide.
Do not take the oral solution if you take disulfiram.
To make sure sertraline is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have or have ever had:
liver problems
kidney problems
heart problems, or risk factors for a heart rhythm problem called QTc prolongation
bipolar disorder or mania
seizures or convulsions
low sodium levels in your blood
bleeding problems, or you take a medicine that thins the blood
narrow angles in the eye or glaucoma
a stroke or high blood pressure
Pregnancy:
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or become pregnant while taking sertraline.
Studies of women exposed to sertraline in the first trimester suggest no overall difference in the risk of major birth defects.
This difference is compared with the background rate.
Some studies have reported increases in specific defects.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "has pregnancy instruction", "inform doctor if pregnant, planning pregnancy, or become pregnant while taking sertraline"]

The relation 'has pregnancy instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires specific instructions or actions to be taken by patients who are pregnant or planning to become pregnant, as described by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? B. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are to be managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
C. 'has use indication': The subject drug may be used for the medical purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
